description: This Go source file provides functions for masking and unmasking parts of markdown text, such as code snippets, links, and URLs, by replacing them with placeholders and restoring them later.

methods.name: maskMarkdown
methods.description: Masks various markdown patterns in the input text with placeholders, updating a mapping of placeholders to original substrings.

methods.name: maskMatches
methods.description: Helper function that finds matches of a given regex in text and replaces them with placeholders.

methods.name: maskLinkURLs
methods.description: Replaces URLs within markdown links with placeholders.

methods.name: unmaskMarkdown
methods.description: Restores original substrings into text by replacing placeholders based on the mapping.

methods.name: validatePlaceholders
methods.description: Checks that all placeholders are present in the given text.
